_about: Golden scheduler sequence (tests/Unit/Automation/SchedulerGoldenTest.php): per scenario, every job the ticks enqueued, as [tick time (UTC), job type, priority] (+ payload and delay when not empty). Recorded on the WP1 fork state (e160656); rewrite only on purpose with LGA_GOLDEN_UPDATE=1.

defaults.about: Fresh install with the default settings and no data: the quiet window after the activation, then every cadence (hourly, 6-hourly, daily, weekly) and the digest-driven monitor check.

work_waiting.about: Defaults with the daily digest off and rows that the continuous stages wait for: a prospect to evaluate, then one without opportunities, an approved submission, an approved outreach message (sent only inside the weekday 9-17 send window of the site zone) and a backlink due for its check.
events: the owner switches the daily digest off
the prospect is qualified (no opportunity yet)
an opportunity is recorded for it
an outreach message is approved (Friday 04:00 site time, before the send window opens)
a backlink is due for its check
the backlink is checked (next check in 7 days)
the message is sent (Monday 14:00 site time)

autopilot_on.about: Defaults with Autopilot switched on by the owner two minutes after the activation (internal links become daily).

modules_off.about: Defaults with the discovery and monitoring stages switched off and backlink imports every 3 days; discovery comes back on day 4 and imports go off on day 5.
events: the owner switches discovery and monitoring off and sets imports to every 3 days

paused.about: Defaults with background work paused for 28 hours (the lga_pause_background filter, as while a backup runs), from +18 h to +46 h after the install: nothing is enqueued meanwhile, and what came due runs once afterwards.

automation_off.about: Defaults with the automation master switch off from day 2 to day 3.
